THIS IS A GREATLY USEFUL FEATURE TO PINPOINT WHERE AND WHAT GOT HUNGUP VISUALLY AS FAST REFERENCE. 2. Comprehensive Logging, 3. They output should be informative, stylized but not exposition. Report essential milestones of whatever the cli is installing; NOT all outbut; but also do not remove all LOGGING output either.   1. FOR EXAMPLE: "IF error tripped; break 'minimal'output to deliver the FULL ERROR, similar to how good quality linters do WITH Color, highlighting, animations
